name: Whist
tagline: The classic partnership trick game: the dealer's last card names trumps.
rulesSummary: Four players, partners sitting across. All 52 cards are dealt, 13 each.
The dealer's last card is turned face up: its suit is trumps. The dealer picks it up on playing to the first trick.
The player left of the dealer leads. Follow suit if you can; otherwise play anything, trump or not. The highest trump wins, or else the highest card of the suit led.
The side that takes more tricks scores 1 point for each trick over six. First side to 5 wins (7 or 10 for a longer game).
Option, honours: the side dealt all four of A K Q J of trumps scores 4, three of them 2 — but not a side already one point from winning.
